hooks.name: Run npm run check after each spec task
hooks.description: Runs lint, format check, build and tests after a spec task finishes.

hooks.name: Agent runs npm run check and fixes failures after each spec task
hooks.description: Fallback: the command hook output may not reach the agent, so the agent runs the check itself.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Run `npm run check` from the repository root. If anything fails (lint, format, build or tests), read the error output, fix the cause, and run `npm run check` again until it passes. Follow working-rules: propose code changes to Luis Miguel before modifying code outside the task's scope. Do not commit.
